rows.note: Real TinyHttpd socket, trustProxy(true): block is Host, client lines (forwarding names dropped in all cases, Cookie merged), X-Forwarded-For 1.2.3.4, 5.6.7.8, 127.0.0.1 / Proto https / Host gw.example, then .requestHeader values in call order, Connection: close. AC-8 holds.

Untrusted TinyHttpd peer: duplicated and case-variant X-Forwarded-Host, Forwarded, X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-Port, X-Forwarded-Prefix, X-Forwarded-Proto all dropped; only the proxy's three lines arrive.
preserveHost(true) with a trusted CIDR peer and removeRequestHeader(X-Real-IP): Host and X-Forwarded-Host both the received Host, client forwarding variants dropped.
Later call wins across letter case and set/remove kinds; surviving values follow the forwarding lines in the order of their later call.
All 16 managed names refused in mixed case by requestHeader and removeRequestHeader; X-Real-IP, X-Forwarded-Port, X-Forwarded-Prefix stay configurable.
90 TinyHttpd requests (HEAD, 204, 304, read-to-close, chunked, 404, refused backend 502, POST) leave 0 queued reservations.
50 https requests whose TLS handshake fails at once: the handshake deadline on the shared scheduler and the total reservation are both cancelled (queue 0).
Watchdog thread created from a request thread holding a custom context class loader: single thread, name naruserve-proxy-watchdog, daemon, null context class loader.
Inconclusive: skipped by assumption, TinyHttpd listen(0) refuses connections on ::1 (IPv4-only bind). Not a defect; AC-2 is covered by the in-memory adapter tests.
HTTP/1.0 without Host over TinyHttpd, trusted peer, two client X-Forwarded-Host lines: no client value reaches the backend.

Chunked POST over TinyHttpd, trusted CIDR peer: Host, client lines, X-Forwarded-For 1.2.3.4, 127.0.0.1 / Proto / Host, Via and X-Z requestHeader values, framing header, Connection: close; body relayed.
Client that resets mid-way through a 12.8 MB streamed body over TinyHttpd: no reservation remains in the queue.
